data.name: Undead World Order
data.detailed_description:
UPDATES

THE YEAR 1 ANNIVERSARY UPDATE IS NOW LIVE!

The biggest update since launch is here! Experience reworked and faster-paced gameplay, redesigned and improved enemies and arenas, a complete audio overhaul, UI improvements, and more!


About the Game

UNRELENTING FIREPOWER. ENDLESS HORDES OF THE UNDEAD. STEEL MEETS ROTTING FLESH... 

Face off against the onslaught of overwhelming zombie hordes in this fast-paced top-down 2D arcade shoot-'em-up, where survival depends on firepower, movement, and the all-out destruction of everything around you...

Take command of your choice of heavily armed tanks and battle against hundreds of zombies on-screen at once as you fight for survival in this fallen world. Rip enemies apart with relentless heavy machine guns and cannons, smashing through any barricades, vehicles, and zombies in your way...

Survive through fast-paced replayable arenas, each throwing increasingly freakish and dangerous hordes of zombies at you. Navigate corn fields at night, abandoned city districts, and more. Stay alive until the timer expires, or be ripped apart and eaten by the undead hordes all around you...

FACE MASSIVE UNDEAD HORDES

  • Stand alone against hundreds of zombies on-screen at once.

  • Survive the onslaught of thousands of undead throughout the course of each arena.

  • Encounter freakish enemy types, including exploding zombies, massive behemoths, and other deadly infected.

COMMAND POWERFUL TANKS

  • Select your tank from 3 unique options, including the heavy, medium, and light tanks.

  • Unleash bullets and tank shells in multiple directions at once using a specialized control scheme.

  • Experiment with different playstyles and strategies to survive.

OBLITERATE EVERYTHING

  • Use brute force to run over and crush enemies under your tank.

  • Dispense chaos with explosions that tear apart the environment and send zombies and debris colliding into each other.

SURVIVE A DYING WORLD

  • Fight through 7 arenas overrun with the undead hordes.

  • Battle across corn fields, abandoned buildings, downtown intersections, and more.

EXPERIENCE BONUS CONTENT

  • Track lifetime zombie kills.

  • Read the archives to see the fall of the world.

  • Unlock a bonus tower-defense inspired challenge level.

THE UNDEAD HORDES ARE HERE. ARE YOU READY?

data.short_description: Undead World Order is a 2D zombie horde shoot-'em-up where you take command of heavily armed tanks to obliterate the flesh-hungry zombie hordes and everything else standing between you and survival.

  • Memory: 12 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11
